heroEnd: into workflows you can see and control
intro: Bring your algorithms into SfM, NeRF, and 3DGS workflows with Packs.
execution: Each algorithm runs in its own process and the environment you configure.
canvasAlt: HoloLab canvas showing video processing, COLMAP reconstruction, and STG training and export, with camera and point-cloud previews.
canvasCaption: Video processing, COLMAP reconstruction, and STG training connected on the canvas.
canvasNote: Actual interface. Device IDs, execution times, and source image previews are hidden.
connectBody: Describe inputs, outputs, parameters, and an execution command in a manifest, then use the algorithm in your workflow.
typesBody: Port type checks tell you what is wrong as you connect nodes.
statusBody: Inspect each step’s progress, logs, and status, and stop execution when you need to.
statusNote: Progress reporting depends on the Pack.
resultsTitle: Revisit the outputs of a run
resultsBody: Runs leave a record. Preview artifacts and locate the files they refer to.
resultsNote: Opening a file location requires Flops Cobrowser integration.
audienceBody: Researchers working with SfM, NeRF, or 3D Gaussian Splatting, and developers bringing existing algorithms into a visual workflow.
startBody: Install HoloLab, then add nodes, connect them, choose a device, and run your workflow.
useIntro: Install HoloLab, build your first workflow, and inspect the results.
buildIntro: Write a Pack and learn how algorithms, workflows, and the type system fit together.
referenceIntro: Detailed rules for Packs, workflow files, artifacts, and workspaces.
notFoundBody: The link may have changed. Try the documentation index.
englishNotice: English original. A Chinese edition is planned for the next batch.
futureNotice: The “Future direction” section describes plans that are not implemented.
libIntro: Drop files here, then choose which compute nodes should receive them.
libDropHint: Choose a destination before uploading. Multiple files are welcome.
libResumeHint: After reopening this page, select the original file to resume. Its checksum is verified before missing chunks are uploaded.
libEmpty: This folder has no resources yet.
libWrongFile: This is not the original file. Select a file with the same size and SHA-256.
